name: EmptyState
description: Explains why there's nothing here and what to do next: an icon tile, a title, a description and usually one primary action.

props.name: variant
props.description: Why it's empty: nothing created yet, a search or filter matched nothing, or everything is done. Picks the tile's tint and default icon. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: md for a page or card; sm for a panel. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: align
props.description: Centered, or aligned to the start in the reading direction. Emitted as data-align.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name from the registry. Defaults to the variant's: inbox, search-x or circle-check. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: title
props.description: Why it's empty, as a heading.

props.name: description
props.description: What to do next. The default slot (children) fills it too.

props.name: actions
props.description: The buttons: one primary action, maybe a secondary one.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level, 2 to 6, to fit the container's outline.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', actions: '…' }.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The icon tile, tinted by the variant, hidden from assistive technology.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Rich description. The default slot fills it too.

requirements: The title is a heading at the right level for its container (headingLevel).
The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title and description carry the meaning.
Text keeps 4.5:1 and the tile is decorative, in every theme.

props.title: No properties yet
props.description: Add your first property to start tracking visits, offers and revenue.
